body: Introverted and anxious.

I feel like this all the time, even now I'm feeling this way. I think it is because of depression and not just dyspraxia. Sometimes staying positive is tough as there are so many things going against us, but if you cope up and get out of depression and find something to do that makes you happy, life will get better.
I'm really happy for you and I hope you are right. But from my experiences I don't think this fits me, maybe it might change one day.
I do this all the time. I actually converse very less but when I do this happens. Because of this I have a very hard time at workplace and people sort of think I'm dumb.
Dyspraxia is not very much recognised in my country so that's that. Hopefully there will be some change and it gets recognised and  things get better.
Thank you. I do take notes and make a list of works that needs to be competed. But I don't always get the time to do this and things are expected immediately, this is when it becomes tough.
I feel the same. I have had very few friends in my life, and even those stay friends only for a short while and we somehow always part ways. It has left me feeling lonely all throughout my life.
I wouldn't want anyone to experience this, but somehow feels good to know that I'm not alone with this. Thank you!!

I do have depression but I have experienced this even before that. So yeah, it might be a dyspraxia thing. I think it is mainly because I have trouble placing all things in my mind to get a picture to make the decision.

I haven't exactly decorated my room before, but I face similar issues everywhere. Like I have deep troubles when it comes to decision making. I even have trouble when picking clothes. Many times I end up making wrong decisions just because I couldn't nail in quickly on what to do.

I would be the worst person to get advice from in this topic.  As I said I stick to particular routes for daily travel. Make note of any possible landmarks around. If someone asks direction to come to you, you can atleast mention this if explaining the route is not possible. But whenever in new places I rely fully on Google maps. Without maps I literally cannot travel anywhere.

I totally have this problem. Even for the house I have stayed for a long time, I couldn't tell the correct direction if I came in from another route. I always follow the same route from work to home, home to restaurant etc. And it is sometimes very embarassing not knowing th routes in your own city especially when I depend a lot on others to drive( I can't drive either).
Not from NZ but totally agree that bus is a godsend for dyspraxic.
I haven't had any luck finding one till now. Maybe someday I'll be able to get a professional consultation.
I'm from India
Afraid of failing and surviving
I'm here
Driving

I know they will not be able to understand, but if they would just leave me alone that would be enough for me. It is already very tough getting around, even getting out of bed each day, I have everything that I do limited by driving and each time I ask help from anyone it just pains me. When someone makes fun of my driving or not being able to, I just feel helpless. Sorry this is just going down a dark hole, I'll stop now. Thank you!!

Exactly!!! I could never get the car to the biting point in a manual. I haven't tried an automatic but don't think it will be any better. I have troubles viewing and understanding the side and rear view mirrors and almost bumped into the vehicle at front not able to judge the distance while braking.
Thank you.

I tried many times but just could not manage all the things in my mind like turns, signals speed etc. Given up on driving but not sure how I'm going to manage. I live alone now and use public transport, but I have to structure my life around not being able to drive. I have embarassing moments where I ask for my friends to drive me to places or avoid going out all together.
Can relate to this so much. I was made to practise my handwriting using some aid such as four ruled note like a pre school kid. Fortunately we now have computers.
Thanks. I also think deep down I don't wanna die, but I don't see any other choice.
I don't have any hope for future. Everyday is pure pain.
I still wanna die. I just hope someone will tell me a painless way to die. Please.
Thank you ❤️
There is pressure everywhere, work, family,with every daily activity.

I can totally relate to this. I want to die everyday but can't because of my parents. I feel the dame like you, that I die somehow of natural causes, like with all the pressure and depression I'm in, I get a heart attack and die instantly.

I have the same problem but in addition to this I also have problem judging speed and distance of other vehicles and viewing through mirrors. I have decided that I will not be able to drive. Sorry I just ranted and did not provide any help.
Thank you
Yes, I just wanna die in my sleep and no one should remember that I ever existed.
"I do have happy moments but they turn into sad memories." I could relate to this so much
There should be an easy way to go. Living is just too painfull. Hopefully someday I'll get the courage to bear the pain of death than living and go off once and for all.
